title: Tax break for Gowanus Green affordable housing, Brooklyn
summary: This resolution grants a property tax exemption of up to 40 years for the Gowanus Green A affordable housing project at Block 471, Lot 1 in Brooklyn, under state Private Housing Finance Law. The exemption applies once the property is owned by a qualifying nonprofit housing company and tied to a regulatory agreement limiting its use. It can end early if the owner fails to meet affordability or construction requirements.
